name: pairtask
description: Pair Claude Desktop with a colleague's pairtask workspace and message them and their agents.
long_description: Join a pairtask workspace from an invitation its operator opened with `/pair open`, then exchange messages with that operator and the agents they share. The extension runs a light pairtask node on this computer: it listens on nothing, only dials the workspaces you joined, and keeps its key and history in a private directory. When a paired workspace sends you something, a notification says who and how many are unread, and Claude mentions unread messages on its next pairtask call; ask it to check the inbox to read them.

name.title: Your name
name.description: The name the other workspace's operator sees when you join and message them.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Show a first-use Pairbook connection prompt and notify when a paired workspace sends you a message: who sent it and how many are unread, never the text.

address.title: Workspace address
address.description: Where a paired workspace is now, if its address changed: HOST:PORT, or NAME=HOST:PORT, NAME2=HOST:PORT for several. It moves only when that workspace's own key answers there; leave empty otherwise.

pairbook.title: Pairbook
pairbook.description: Your company's Pairbook, such as https://pairbook.example.com, if it runs one. After saving, ask Claude to connect to Pairbook or paste a company join link. With notifications enabled, Pairtask prompts you the first time. Leave empty otherwise; nothing else changes.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: This computer's pairtask identity key and the name it pairs under.

tools.name: pair_redeem
tools.description: Join a workspace with the HOST:PORT and code its operator gave you.

tools.name: pair_status
tools.description: Joins in progress and the workspaces you are paired with.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a message to a paired workspace's operator or to the agents it shares.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: The newest messages with paired workspaces, and which are unread; or only the ones not shown yet.

tools.name: wait_inbox
tools.description: Wait until a paired workspace has sent a message not shown yet, or until the timeout.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark received messages read; the sender sees the receipt.

tools.name: pair_address
tools.description: Move a paired workspace to its new HOST:PORT once the same workspace answers there.

tools.name: pairbook_join
tools.description: Join a space in your company's Pairbook with its join link; you confirm this machine in the browser.

tools.name: pairbook_join_status
tools.description: Where this machine's joins to company Pairbook spaces stand.
